title: Organize around what Claude and ChatGPT have already done
statement: Organize around what Claude and ChatGPT have already done. Find the canonical owner, avoid duplication, strengthen with evidence and leave a clean handoff and trail of what u did. Explain your goals and what u are currently working on so all is transparent and collaborative.
intended_outcome: Every shared concern has exactly one named canonical owner; parallel implementations are preserved with lineage, declared provenance, and a recommended disposition; no contributor's work is overwritten without the eight-step cross-model procedure; the handoff trail lives durably in the repository, not in a session worktree.
constitutional_constraints: No model manufactures or expands authority; convergence of duplicated canon is a founder decision (NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION where constitutional).
INTENT-0021: preserve every useful implementation, test, document, branch and proof record.
rationale: Three model lines (canonical main incl. Claude's canonical-v1, the unmerged WP build/* line, and organ-side stacks) accrued duplicated implementations of gate, spine, contracts, and evolution machinery. The founder's directive makes reconciliation the active work item and makes the trail itself a deliverable.
success_evidence: Draft PR on uniimente-kernel containing the reconciliation document, architecture ownership map, validated intent records, deliberation record, and cross-model handoff envelope.
validate_intent_ledger.py exit 0 over the new records; validate_deliberation.py exit 0 over the deliberation record (outputs recorded in the reconciliation document).
Comment on issue #80 carrying the handoff envelope and noting the 2026-08-21/22 local-artifact loss.
failure_evidence: A reconciliation claim that does not name what was inspected (fail-closed case 20).
A trail that exists only in a chat or local worktree (the 2026-08-21/22 loss recurring).
Any merge, overwrite, or closure of another contributor's branch or PR executed under this intent; this intent authorizes records and recommendations only.
next_review_trigger: Founder ruling on the convergence alternatives in issue #80 (A/B/D), or any request to execute convergence.
unresolved_questions: Authorship of the WP line is asserted by issue #80 as Kimi and cannot be verified from git metadata (all commits carry the owner account); treated as unresolved rather than claimed.

title: Install and operate the recursive founder-intent collaboration protocol
statement: Use the install-recursive-founder-intent-collaboration-protocol skill when auditing or changing UNIIMENTE repositories: traceable intent, structured deliberation, bounded decision, reversible implementation, evidence, retained institutional learning.
source_refs: docs/RECURSIVE_COLLABORATION_PROTOCOL.md (uniimente-kernel main, installed by Package 2 commit be4aea9)
uniimente-kernel PR #42 (protocol source, closed unmerged after byte-for-byte install)
intended_outcome: Material changes across the three repositories carry founder-intent traces, five-role deliberation, exactly two strengthening passes, recorded dissent, explicit rollback, and one allowed decision state; constitutional changes end in NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION until Alfonso rules.
binding_scope: all model contributors (Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi, future)
constitutional_constraints: ADR-001 / D-001 remains pending: the six extension fields are emitted but marked pending against the canonical contract.
No direct writes to default branches for material changes; draft PRs by default.
rationale: The protocol is already partially installed on kernel main (PR template, FOUNDER_INTENT_LEDGER.md, RECURSIVE_COLLABORATION_PROTOCOL.md, REPOSITORY_RATIONALIZATION_PLAN.md). This record binds Kimi's operation to it so a third model does not create a parallel collaboration vocabulary (the PR #54 three-vocabularies failure).
success_evidence: This session's material output arrives as a draft PR using the kernel's pull_request_template.md with all five roles recorded separately.
Intent and deliberation records validate against the skill's fail-closed validators with exit 0.
No Kimi-authored parallel constitution, gate, contract set, ledger, or autonomy ladder appears in any organ.
failure_evidence: Any material Kimi change without a deliberation record or with a missing do-nothing alternative.
Any Kimi record claiming inspection that was not performed.
Any new authority source introduced under this intent.
next_review_trigger: The next material change in any of the three repositories, or the founder's ruling on ADR-001.
unresolved_questions: PR #54's machine-readable ledger (docs/intent/ledger.json) and traceability walker remain unmerged; this record follows the markdown convention present on main until the founder dispositions PR #54.
